question: In which city is the Salar Jung Museum situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The **Salar Jung Museum** is an** art museum **situated in **Hyderabad, Telangana, India** in **Dar-ul-Shifa**, on the** southern bank of the Musi River**.
 
• It is notable for being the** third-largest museum** in India and for having the **greatest one-man collection of antiquities **in the world.
 
• It is well-known throughout India for its** priceless collections** from many civilizations.
 
• It was established in **1951.**
 
• The major portion of the collection of the museum was acquired by **Mir Yousuf Ali Khan, **popularly known as **Salar Jung III.**
